finalPrompt: Create one original unofficial fan-made full-body static game plate of the licensed 2022 Bionic Predator class from Predator: Hunting Grounds. Use a strict three-quarter side profile facing right on a pure opaque #00FF00 background. Keep the huge hunter visibly organic with dark mottled skin, veteran black dreadlocks, exposed mandibles and no biomask. Show an asymmetrical, logically continuous gunmetal reconstruction on one side: red bionic eye and facial plate, mandible brace, reinforced shoulder and forearm, torso interfaces and one reinforced lower leg. Keep the other side organic, all cables anchored, the caster attached, no held weapon, and both hands readable. Keep the complete character, hands, dreadlocks and feet inside the portrait frame with padding. No floor, shadow, scenery, text, logo, UI, watermark, collage, full robot, human face, extra limbs, malformed hands, floating machinery, Stone Heart identity, checkerboard or fake transparency.
